Sponge for upgraded comfort: Both high density sponge and pocket spring featuring elasticity bring upgraded comfort to you whether you sit or lie in a relaxing position. Soft linen fabric with good tactility will offer your family comfortable sitting experience.
Sturdy structure: Constructed with hardwood frame, the sofa is to provide long term service time. The sofa chair is sturdy enough to withstand a maximum weight capacity of 1100 lbs. Comes with thickened legs that will support you firmly and ensure superior steadiness.
U-shaped sectional sofa set, comes with a sofa and two free pillows. Fashionable with fabric upholstery.
The upholstered contemporary sofa design made of soft fabric can be arranged in various ways for large spacious living areas to accommodate different spaces and used with other furniture's. Optimal softness with extra padded cushioning gives sofa relaxing feeling. All backrests' and cushions' covers are removable to wash,and make it easy cleaning.
 Storage Space: This sectional sofa with removable storage ottoman will make the addition to your den or living room. The convenient space in the storage ottoman provides the place to put blankets and magazines.

Package contains: 1 sofa
